checks.test: exactly nine infantry in three factions
typing animation advances in real engine frames
AI does not override player faction
AI assigns protected stations instead of rushing objective
rifle damage waits for visible projectile arrival
projectile impact applies damage and sparks
rocket penetrates tank armor, small arms are ineffective
explosive damages both direct target and splash neighbour
rifle single shots and SMG rapid fire have distinct cadences
nearby infantry uses bayonet even during reload
bayonet consumes no ammunition and reports melee state
analytic LOS detects sub-cell thin blockers
formation offset will not detour around far side of sharpener
small repeated movement orders do not trigger A* storms
bayonet cannot stab through pencil cover
hard cover has a hidden rest station and reachable peek corner
soldier moves to shoulder peek before shooting around hard cover
reload retracts soldier behind hard cover
pinned soldier remains hidden instead of exposing shoulder
hidden hard-cover soldier cannot shoot through obstacle
soldier actually traverses to corner and fires during the peek window
cover selection evaluates multiple threats, firing arc and route cost
destroyed cover invalidates soldier station and reservation
destroyed cover actually clears old infantry and tank navigation cells
Blender tank exposes independent turret and muzzle nodes
tank front armor is stronger than rear armor
nearby anti-tank threat triggers standoff reverse destination
tank actually reverses along a reachable path
turret aims independently while hull manoeuvres
squad move creates one shared virtual formation anchor
destination formation does not stack members on one point
virtual leader leash prevents anchor running away from stationary squad
leader death updates leader without swapping surviving weapon roles
new contact stops virtual formation before taking combat positions
having a firing arc without recent covering shots does not authorize a bound
suppressed enemy permits exactly one CQB flanker while two soldiers hold
CQB flank destination defeats enemy cover direction
loss of covering fire cancels flank and seeks immediate shelter
healthy unsuppressed enemy does not invite an unsupported rush
rejected attack cannot cancel an active squad plan or steal control
mouse release preserves full camera drag even when motion events are coalesced
top camera preserves screen axes during interpolated multi-frame pan
